data.one_liner: Cross-platform wrapper for dart:ffi and wasm_ffi to support native platforms and web.
data.what_it_does: A thin cross-platform facade providing a consistent Foreign Function Interface (FFI) API across native platforms and the web using wasm_ffi. Includes helper utilities for platform-aware library loading and memory management.
use_when: You need to use FFI bindings in a Flutter or Dart project targeting both native and web platforms.
You want a unified way to load dynamic libraries or WebAssembly modules using FfiHelper.
avoid_when: Your project does not target the web and standard dart:ffi is sufficient.
You rely heavily on FFI features not supported on web by wasm_ffi, such as Array, Struct, or Union.
strengths: Consistent API across all platforms including web
Helper utilities for asynchronous library loading and memory management
weaknesses: Web platform has limitations on certain dart:ffi features like Array, Struct, and Union
Requires manual compilation and asset management for WebAssembly or Emscripten binaries
data.setup_notes: Requires replacing standard dart:ffi imports with universal_ffi/ffi.dart, compiling C/C++ source code to shared libraries for desktop/mobile and WASM/JS for web, and setting up module loading.
